summary.text: Mike McCaffree is the Democratic candidate for Missouri State Senate District 28 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 4 Democratic primary.
He is a real estate broker and a member of the Nevada R-V School District board.

paragraphs.text: Mike McCaffree was born in Nevada, Missouri, graduated from Nevada High School in 1987, and received a degree in political science from Westminster College in 1991.

His career experience includes working as a real estate broker, and he has been affiliated with the Realtors Land Institute, the National Association of Realtors, the Council of Residential Specialists and Ducks Unlimited.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he has worked as a real estate broker since 1997, has five children with his wife, Julia, and had served on the local Board of Education for 16 years.
McCaffree sought the Democratic nomination for Missouri's 4th Congressional District in 2024 but was defeated in the primary.
In the same survey he listed public schools and career technical education funding, and more affordable housing, among his key messages.
